# BuyDey

BuyDey is a Ghana marketplace for searching prices and buying or selling products and services across all 16 regions of Ghana.

Canonical site: https://buydey.vercel.app/
Marketplace: https://buydey.vercel.app/#market
Safety centre: https://buydey.vercel.app/safety.html
Terms: https://buydey.vercel.app/terms.html
Privacy: https://buydey.vercel.app/privacy.html

BuyDey standard seller listings are free. Buyers should inspect items before payment, keep conversations on BuyDey and prefer identity-verified sellers.
